info.name: SGITU - G10 Gateway x G6 Paiement
info.description: Collection Postman complete pour verifier la relation Client -> G10 -> G6 Paiement. Elle couvre health public, JWT, routage, comptes de paiement, transactions, factures, remboursements, erreurs 400/401 et resilience 503.

exec: const payload = { sub: email, userId: String(userId), roles: roles, iat: now, exp: now + ttlSeconds, jti: 'g6-postman-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) };
pm.test('G6 health via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('G6 paths documented/routed', function () { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('/api/payments'); pm.expect(text).to.include('/api/payment-accounts'); });
pm.test('Sans JWT refuse par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: 02 - Donnees de test G6 via G10

exec: pm.test('Test cards accessibles avec JWT', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Test mobile money accessible avec JWT', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Save first account id', function () { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array'); if (arr.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentAccountId', String(arr[0].id)); } });

item.name: 04 - Paiements et factures G6 via G10

exec: pm.test('Save first payment id', function () { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array'); if (arr.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentId', String(arr[0].paymentId || arr[0].id)); } });
pm.test('Invoice found or business error', function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('Payment response has id/status', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('paymentId'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('status'); pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentId', String(json.paymentId)); });
if ([200, 201].includes(pm.response.code)) { const json = pm.response.json(); if (json.refundId || json.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('refundId', String(json.refundId || json.id)); } }
pm.test('Refunds by user accessible', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 06.1 - G6 down -> 503 via G10
item.description: Avant ce test manuel : docker stop sgitu-int-payment-service. Si G6 tourne encore, la reponse peut etre 200.

exec: pm.test('G6 up ou indisponible gere proprement', function () { pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 503) { pm.test('Gateway error code coherent', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'); }); }
